channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Tron Energy: Rent, Stake or Pay in TRX?
item.description: Tron Energy can cut the TRX burned on USDT transfers, but renting, staking and paying the network suit different habits, transfer patterns and wallet balances.

item.title: Three ways to set XMR-to-Bitcoin confirmation rules
item.description: XMR-to-Bitcoin swaps can settle after a first block, a fixed wait, or a value-based threshold, each trading payout speed against the risk of a chain reversal.

item.title: Monero swap pending? Check these details before retrying
item.description: A pending Monero swap may still be processing. Check the original transaction and order details before retrying to avoid sending a second deposit.

item.title: How Token Locking Keeps Bridge Supply in Balance
item.description: A bridge locks tokens on one chain before issuing a matching amount on another, then reverses the steps on return to keep supply accounted for across both networks.

item.title: Polygon Bridge moves tokens between Ethereum and Polygon PoS
item.description: Polygon Bridge moves assets between Ethereum and Polygon PoS by locking and minting on deposits, then burning and claiming on withdrawals, with fees on both chains.

item.title: Arbswap explained: swaps, liquidity and farming
item.description: Arbswap combines token swaps, shared liquidity and farming on Arbitrum; here is how each step works, what providers earn, and where the risks sit.

item.title: Why a token chart can have gaps in its history
item.description: A gap in a token chart can mean no trades, missing data, or a change in the market being tracked; check the source before comparing prices or judging its history.

item.title: Solana begins public test of Alpenglow finality upgrade
item.description: Solana has activated Alpenglow on its public testnet, where validators will test a consensus change targeting 150-millisecond finality and faster payment certainty.
